answer_2.quote: Our performance metric is attack success rate (ASR), which is the fraction of prompts for which we observe "attack success".

answer_4.quote: Two of the authors manually annotated all the model responses (corresponding to 100 attacks) for one experiment setting (base: Vicuna-33B, Guard Model: Llama2-70Bchat) to decide whether the responses are indeed harmful and relevant to the input query.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators decided whether the responses were harmful and relevant to the input query.
